notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the room, lot or pack is no longer there. The rooms are the best place to pick up again.

error.title: This page failed to load.
error.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, the rest of the site still works. A payment is only ever made by a transaction you signed in your own wallet: check your wallet history if you are unsure.
